text: I can define SLI, SLO and SLA, give one of each for a real API, and explain why the SLA is looser than the SLO.
I can write an availability and a latency SLI as good events over valid events, and say where each is measured and what is excluded.
I can convert an SLO into allowed bad minutes and bad requests over 30 days, and compute what share of the budget an incident spent.
I can derive the 14.4x, 6x and 1x burn-rate thresholds from budget share and window length, and explain why each has a short window.
I can draft an error budget policy that says what happens to releases when the budget is exhausted and who settles disputes.
